description: Get model answers without giving callers the provider key. Ask a question, request a structured decision, embed text, or look up models, prices and the account's credit. Send ask with a prompt, or one of the methods below.
author: Sergey Porfiriev

ask.help: Get a model answer. Send prompt text for a text reply with its tokens and cost, or an OpenAI chat request for the provider response as JSON.

args.name: prompt
args.help: Prompt text, or an OpenAI chat-completions object in JSON; text returns assistant text, an object returns provider JSON

decide.help: Get answers to typed decision questions. Send an OpenRouter Decisions request; the reply is the full provider response as JSON.

args.name: body
args.help: Raw JSON request, including state, questions and the decision model; sent unchanged

models.help: List the provider's models as a table: context length, USD per million input and output tokens, input kinds; the configured default is marked. With --images, image models and their price per image or megapixel, with image_model marked.

args.name: json
args.help: Return the provider's full records instead of the table

args.name: filter
args.help: Keep models whose ID or name contains this word; free keeps free models

model.help: See one model's context length, prices and input kinds, per provider endpoint; for an image model, its parameters and prices per endpoint.

embed.help: Turn text into vectors. Send a JSON string, a JSON list of strings, or {"input":...,"model":...}; the reply is the model and one vector per text. Other text after embed is a prompt.

args.name: input
args.help: A JSON string, a JSON list of strings, or an object with input and an optional model; too many texts for one answer are refused

key.help: See the key's spend limit, remaining credit and rate limit, never the key itself

image.help: Generate images; not available yet: #ai cannot store images until it serves itself. Only a JSON object is a request; other text after image is a prompt.

args.name: request
args.help: A JSON object with prompt, and optionally model, n (1 to 4), aspect_ratio, resolution, size, output_format, quality, background, seed and input_references (https or data:image URLs)

model.help: Default chat model ID for ask/text and chat JSON requests without model; not injected into decide

embed_model.help: Default embedding model ID for embed requests without model

image_model.help: Default image model ID for image requests without model; models --images marks it

base_url.help: Trusted OpenAI-compatible API root; ask, embed and the lookup methods append their path, decide uses the same origin at /api/alpha/decisions
